# Préparation des données
Installation des librairies et importation des données
```{r, setup, results='hide', message=FALSE}
source("support/preparation.R")
individus_CS8_short <- individus %>%
  var_labels(
    CS8 = "PCS niv. 1"
  ) %>%
  val_labels(
    CS8 = c(
      "Agri." = "1",
      "Art." = "2",
      "CPIS" = "3",
      "P.I." = "4",
      "Empl." = "5",
      "Ouvr." = "6",
      "Retr." = "7",
      "Autres" = "8"
    )
  )
```

# Exploration

## Distribution des temps de déplacements par jour et par personne

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(survey)

temps_quotid_personne <- deplacements %>%
  group_by(NQUEST, NP) %>%
  summarise(temps = sum(DUREE)) %>%
  left_join(individus_CS8_short, by = c("NQUEST", "NP")) %>%
  mutate(temps = tidyr::replace_na(temps, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CS8)) %>%
  mutate(CS8 = sjlabelled::as_label(CS8, prefix = TRUE))

dw <- svydesign(ids = ~1,
                data = temps_quotid_personne,
                weights = ~POIDSP)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
ggplot(dw$variables, aes(
  weight = weights(dw),
  x = CS8,
  y = temps,
  color = CS8)
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, varwidth = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Distribution de la durée quotidienne des déplacements par personne") +
  ylab("Durée quotid. des déplacements (min)") +
  xlab("PCS de niveau 1") +
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300))
```


```{r, message=FALSE}
svyhist(~temps, dw, main = "Histogramme")
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
moyennes <- svyby(~temps, ~CS8, dw, svymean)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
moyennes <- moyennes %>% rename("Temps moyen (min)" = "temps", "Écart-type" = "se")
knitr::kable(moyennes, caption = "Temps quotidiens de déplacement moyens", digits = 0)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
quartiles <- svyby(~temps, ~CS8, dw, svyquantile, quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), ci = TRUE, vartype= "ci")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
quartiles <- quartiles %>% rename("1er quartile" = "0.25", "Médiane" = "0.5", "3e quartile" = "0.75")
knitr::kable(quartiles[2:4], caption = "Distribution des temps quotidiens de déplacement (quartiles, en min)", digits = 0)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(convey)
cdw <- convey_prep(dw)
gini <- svyby(~temps, ~CS8, cdw, svygini)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
gini <- gini %>% rename("Coefficient de Gini" = "temps", "Écart-type" = "se")
knitr::kable(gini[2], caption = "Temps quotidiens de déplacement moyens")
```

```{r}
library(gglorenz)

temps_quotid_personne <- deplacements %>%
  group_by(NQUEST, NP) %>%
  summarise(temps = sum(DUREE)) %>%
  left_join(individus_CS8_short, by = c("NQUEST", "NP")) %>%
  mutate(temps = tidyr::replace_na(temps, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CS8))

temps_quotid_personne_subset <- subset(temps_quotid_personne, CS8 %in% c(3, 5, 6))
temps_quotid_personne_subset <- temps_quotid_personne_subset %>%
  mutate(CS8 = sjlabelled::as_label(CS8, prefix = TRUE))

dw <- svydesign(ids = ~1,
                data = temps_quotid_personne_subset,
                weights = ~POIDSP)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dw$variables, aes(
  weight = weights(dw),
  x = temps,
  color = CS8)) +
    stat_lorenz(desc = TRUE) +
    coord_fixed() +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Part cumulée des individus",
         y = "Part cumulée des temps de déplacements",
         title = "Inégalités des temps de déplacement")
```
